portfolio.body:
## Purpose

Preserve the complete Portfolio continuation for a new session while retaining the existing merge and deployment holds. This draft uses the canonical Next.js `apps/web` and existing `capirov2` services; it does not implement Meri or Modules.

## Published source

Source-equivalent commit `abaeab37b36d60b3e5185755e1b2c9169d7c92f3` exactly matches local checkpoint `760dcc6c1179312c7f4b762e64cf3af1aad60c3e`, tree `46417a01484727747b0a2d81b3b4f278285cb709`. The 33 local continuation commits and all local branches will be retained in the companion history bundle. Final Watchlist and alert source are preserved byte for byte.

## Verification and remaining work

`npm run check` passed on that exact source: 998 Portfolio units, 32 foundation tests, 21 transport tests, types, public packages, lint, formatting and architecture. Eleven existing image lint warnings remain. Final combined build, production/browser and hosted signed-in acceptance are pending.

Open follow-ups include Intel Watchlist accepted-projection receipt validation, PhoneVerification code-requested copy, and the retained Core-404 entry assertion. Audit remains 337 in-scope rows open, seven pending exclusions, one owner exclusion, zero accepted.

## Integration holds

Common-shell ownership is proposed pending reconciliation. Desired routes are Portfolio `/`, Meri `/meri`, Modules `/modules` plus Settings; current root/auth/client-scope mismatch is documented and not silently changed. Meri consolidation is draft PR #4, last read at `3cc30ff3182e8050d563516607866cf07efe2aef`; refresh before integration and do not duplicate PR #1.

No main merge, deployment, AWS action, live send or new credential flow is authorized by this preservation PR. The detailed handover and exhaustive context packs are being added in a follow-up commit before handoff completion.

Original PR1 history is retained; integrate this consolidated PR, not a duplicate PR1.

Uses the existing Next apps/web, AI SDK Elements Conversation/Message/PromptInput and canonical public 0.1 transport projection. Eight run states and tool/evidence/approval/artifact/checkpoint/usage reference displays are contract-limited; fixtures do not imply live actions or recovery. Figma section/frame references, actual browser evidence and a 280-file context inventory are committed. No Portfolio or Modules UI is implemented here beyond the navigation toggle.

Author checks: 29 root tests, 21 transport tests, types, pins, architecture, clean build and 7 actual browser cases. Primary review: 17 focused architecture checks and 7 browser cases, byte-preservation audit and Figma screenshot binding; it borrowed the author's build and does not claim a second clean build.

SOURCE PRESERVATION ONLY. Portfolio consolidation precedes shared-shell integration: one apps/web, one reviewed image, existing portfolio-preview.app.capiro.ai origin, shared HeaderFrame and authentication/client scope ownership pending reconciliation. No separate Meri UI deployment, no AWS writes, no main merge or production admission.
